hook: Can a deodorant ad break the internet? Let's rank them!
outro: Old Spice or Gillette? Drop your comment below and hit subscribe!

items.line: Gillette's toxic masculinity ad? Way too much drama for shaving cream. C-Tier.
But the Old Spice I'm on a horse guy? Fast, hilarious, and completely legendary. Absolute S-Tier without a doubt!
